name: Cutting
desc: Incisions and wounds of separation. Cuts are gruesome work, an even uglier way to die.

stat.effects: Injuries from Cutting are harder to Treat or provide First-Aid, inflicting a Bane on associated Tests.

name: Crushing
desc: The impressions of fists and hammers. These Injuries are not usually lethal, but generally debilitating.

stat.effects: Crushing Injuries do not inflict Bleeding. When you suffer one, you become Stunned for 1d6 Turns.

name: Piercing
desc: Harm from stabs and arrows. While superior in piercing defenses, this tends to be a very unpredictable form of Risk.

stat.effects: When you suffer a Injury of Minor or greater Severity, you begin to Bleed.

name: Impaling
desc: The greater form of Piercing Damage, Impaling Damage is much the same, but far more lethal.

stat.effects:
The greater form of Piercing Damage, Impaling Damage is much the same, but far more lethal.
- 7-12: -| Graze: Your ears ring, following a trench cut in the air.
- 3-6: Major| Socket Piercer: Grinding friction from a joint rendered useless.
- 2: Lethal| Headshot: Iron through the skull, taking thought and life along the line of flight.

name: Rending
desc: The greater form of Cutting Damage, hewing chops and sweeps of lethal potential.

stat.effects: Harder to treat, as Cutting Injuries. All results, even a Swipe, cause Bleeding.

name: Traumatic
desc: The greater form of Crushing Damage, tremendous force, limbs of awful size, falling beams, crushing and crashing structures.

stat.effects: Unlike Crushing Damage, all results of Minor or greater Severity cause Bleeding.

name: Explosive
desc: Shattering reports and waves of burning heat, ripping, scorching, tearing asunder.

stat.effects:
Shattering reports and waves of burning heat, ripping, scorching, tearing asunder.
- 11-12: -| Minor Concussion: Somehow, you pull away mostly unscathed.
- 4-10: Major| Shelled: The ripping air and wind passes through, not dead, not yet.
- 2-3: Lethal| Obliteration: Gone.

name: Catastrophic
desc: Might without measure, doom in the air, death passing by or through.

stat.effects:
Might without measure, doom in the air, death passing by or through.
- 11-12: -| Providential Turn: A brush, a breath of wind that hardly betrays the Doom that just passed you by.
- 2-10: Lethal| Annihilation: The obvious conclusion.

name: Frost
desc: Black gnawing at the shafts of your bones, rime in the veins, blue lips and cracked skin.

stat.effects: All Frost Damage inflicts the Stunned and Off-Balance Conditions with a Duration in Turns up to the Strain suffered.

name: Voltaic
desc: Electrical power from bolts and blue arcs of light, streaks of hate that freeze the muscles and freeze the heart.

stat.effects: Voltaic Damage Stuns you for Rounds up to your Tier.

name: Incendiary
desc: Burns and caustic lesions, Incendiary Risk is a near promise of lasting harm.

stat.effects: If you suffer sufficient Permanent Strain from Incendiary Damage to be automatically Incapacitated, you die.

name: Chaos
desc: Strange, violating energies that twist the body and mind.

stat.effects:
You suffer Strain equal to the Damage and are Frenzied for 1d6 Rounds. If this rolls 6, you cannot resist the Frenzy at all.
You suffer a penalty of 1 to all Abilities and instantly Panic.

name: Order
desc: The energy of perfection, with all the restrictions and inhibition demanded by flawless Order.

stat.effects:
The energy of perfection, with all the restrictions and inhibition demanded by flawless Order.
- 11-12: -| Release:
- 7-10: Moderate| Chained:
- 2-6: Moderate| Shackled:
